FIELD EXPEDITION · BELLATRIX

The Last Observatory

Beneath a mountain, a ring of mirrors still follows stars that no longer exist. One instrument has stopped moving. Its lens is pointed at your expedition.

Take the timing core →

Gain 65 minerals and 20 science. Exhaust the observatory permanently.

1 order
Let the observatory finish →

Spend 40 credits and 20 minerals to begin restoration research.

Settle this world and operate a Research Enclave for three completed cycles without hostile warships in orbit. Then choose 140 science and 30 credits, or restore an Ancient Observatory for 80 credits, 40 minerals and 60 work. Restoration requires Quantum Archives and one infrastructure slot (or explicit replacement), producing +8 science. The opportunity stays with the world if another empire takes it; progress never expires.

◈ 40 credits · ◇ 20 minerals · 1 order

Requires Resonance Theory

Each choice leaves a permanent record. Restorations use ordinary construction; cancelling keeps the plan but never reopens the salvage choice.
